ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image shows: The inclination angle of the inclined plane is θ, block B is at a lower position on the inclined plane and is held against by the fixed stop plate C, block A is above B, A and B are connected by a light spring, and the inclined plane is smooth. Analyze along the direction of the inclined plane. When initially stationary, A is subjected to the component mg sinθ of gravity downward along the inclined plane; to make A stationary, the spring must act on A upward along the inclined plane, so the initial state of the spring is compressed. Let the compression amount be x0, then kx0 = mg sinθ, giving x0 = mg sinθ/k. When B is just about to leave stop plate C, the supporting force of the stop plate on B is just 0; B is still subjected to mg sinθ downward along the inclined plane, so the spring must pull B upward along the inclined plane, indicating that the spring is stretched at this time. Let the elongation amount be x1, then kx1 = mg sinθ, giving x1 = mg sinθ/k. Before B leaves the stop plate, B has always been fixed and unmoving by the stop plate, so A's displacement along the inclined plane equals the total change in spring length from compression x0 to elongation x1, namely s = x0 + x1 = 2mg sinθ/k.

method.method_draft: 以沿斜面方向为分析轴，先由初始静止求弹簧初始形变量：从图中读出A在B的上方、B被挡板C顶住，弹簧连接A、B且斜面光滑；由于A静止，A受重力沿斜面向下分力mg sinθ，弹簧必须对A沿斜面向上推，因此弹簧初态为压缩，压缩量x0满足kx0=mg sinθ。再分析B刚要离开挡板的瞬间：挡板支持力刚变为0，B沿斜面向下有mg sinθ，弹簧必须沿斜面向上拉B，所以弹簧此时为伸长，伸长量x1满足kx1=mg sinθ。B离开前一直被挡板固定，因此A沿斜面的位移等于弹簧长度从压缩x0变到伸长x1的总变化量，即s=x0+x1=2mg sinθ/k。
